Implementation of the tests/ tree, run by tests/run.sh under Homebrew bash; it [[fb-tests-newproj|serves|tests/ is the concrete suite the tests bead names.]]. The acfs unit tests are ported: tests/unit/newproj (bats and Python), tests/unit/lib (newproj errors and logging) and tests/unit/test_project_bootstrap.py. So are the e2e tests in tests/e2e (bats driving expect), whose PATH hides gum, gh and ru so the scripts drive the read() prompts; the expect navigation uses the explicit <back command. Paths, the macacfs zshrc and the BSD wording are adapted, and the install/update parity tests are skipped. New tests live in tests/unit/macacfs: test_config.bats, test_remote.bats (fake gh and ru on PATH model the remote-first order — gh repo create makes an empty bare repo, gh repo clone and ru sync clone it, ru list --json reports the layout path — covering missing, unauthenticated, name taken, create fails, ru add and ru sync failures, the full create, clone, scaffold and push order, owner-repo layout, a non-ru directory refused with --ru, gh clone without ru, and an existing directory refused, with nothing written when preflight fails, plus flag > env > config precedence and the reviewed plan, apply and resume), test_layout.bats (a fake ru reports flat, owner-repo and full, and the classic, wizard and --plan modes agree; also covers ru absent and an explicit directory) and test_guard.bats (the BASH_VERSINFO guard under /bin/bash). The suite [[fb-lib-newproj-remote-impl|relates-to|The remote and layout tests exercise newproj_remote.sh through fake gh and ru executables.]].
